title: Power shutoff call, text and email script
description: A script for contacting customers or partners during a power shutoff: the audience, the notice window, the words of a call, text or email, how a customer confirms and what happens when a customer cannot be reached. The variant is the channel (call, text or email).

examples: Medical baseline customers on circuit C-114

subject.description: Email subject or text sender line.

script.description: The words to say, text or send. A call script is read by an agent; keep it short and complete.
examples: This is Pinecrest Valley Electric. Because of strong wind and dry conditions we may turn off power to your home starting 6 PM Saturday. If you rely on power for a medical need, say so now and we will connect you to help. Press 1 to confirm you got this message.

confirm.description: How the customer confirms the message was received.
examples: Press 1, or reply YES to confirm.

unreachable.description: What the agent or system does when the customer cannot be reached.
examples: Retry twice at 30-minute intervals, then record the attempt and send a field visit request.
